item.title: Warning: Warning !!!
item.description: Dear authors, the Editorial Board of the journal strictly monitors compliance with the principles of academic integrity. In particular, unscrupulous authors often send an article to several journals at the same time. This is strictly forbidden!Violations will be reported to your supervisors and / or institutions.Please follow these principles - https://publicationethics.org/

item.title: SciView stands with Ukraine
item.description: SciView stands with our friends, colleagues, and family in Ukraine, and with all people of Ukraine. We are a scientific platform with a deep connection to Ukraine. SciView was founded in Ukraine; and we have many Editorial team members who call Ukraine home. The Russian attacks are horrific atrocities and have caused immense suffering, fear, and heartbreak.
